description:
Check a carrier registration form without filing anything.

        Takes the same arguments as ``submit_verification`` except ``attest_authorized``.
        Runs every check Hail can run before filing: purpose rules, credit (402),
        the carrier's current form, duplicates (409), field lengths, each file
        (type, size, and for ``upload_id`` that it is this workspace's verification
        document, uploaded within the last hour), and the form's required fields,
        documents and address (for ``purpose="sms"``, the US texting application).
        Nothing is filed, saved, held or charged, and uploads stay usable.
        Returns ``ok``, ``files`` (slot, upload_id, size_bytes, sha256 per file) and
        ``note``; problems come back as ``problems`` with the field named.
        The carrier runs its own checks at submission.

address.description: Applicant address with ``customer_name``, ``street``, ``city``, ``region``, ``postal_code`` and ``country_code``, when the requirements include one.
address.title: Address

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, such as ``US``.
country_code.title: Country Code

documents.description: Map from each needed document slot to ``{option, fields}``, with the option chosen from that slot in the requirements.
documents.title: Documents

fields.description: Applicant answers keyed by the field names in ``get_verification_requirements``. Choice fields take comma-separated option keys.
fields.title: Fields

files.description: One entry per required file: ``{slot, upload_id}`` with the ``id`` from ``create_file_upload`` (purpose ``verification_document``, uploaded within the last hour), or ``{slot, content_type, content_base64}`` for a very small file. JPEG, PNG or PDF, 10 MiB each, 20 files at most.
files.title: Files

number_id.description: Owned number ID from ``list_numbers``, the same one used for the requirements. Required for toll-free texting verification and when the form asks for the sending number.
number_id.title: Number Id

purpose.description: ``number`` registers an applicant for a number purchase; ``sms`` registers US texting (local 10DLC or toll-free).
purpose.title: Purpose

quote_id.description: ``quote_id`` from ``quote_numbers``, the same one used for the requirements. Required for ``purpose="number"``.
quote_id.title: Quote Id

subject_type.description: Required. The actual applicant, ``person`` or ``business``, matching the requirements.
subject_type.title: Subject Type

name: check_verification
title: Check a verification
